summary: Iteration 97 - Payroll Overhaul & Order Command Bar. All features verified working: (1) Order Command Bar with Pricing Analysis/Calculator/Sketch/Add Ticket/Save buttons on New Order and Add Ticket pages, (2) Payroll report/timesheet now includes carryover_balance, transaction totals, final_owed, and hours+minutes labels, (3) Pay-period summary reflects carryover + transaction adjustments in net_owed, (4) Daily payroll breakdown contains day/date, worked time, daily pay, and daily adjustments, (5) Entry details include punch in/out and break labels, (6) Export UI (CSV/Print) loads correctly on Payroll page.
critical_code_review_comments: Payroll backend correctly calculates carryover_balance from prior unpaid payroll balance before selected start date
Transaction adjustments (earnings - advances - payments) correctly reflected in adjustments_total field
final_owed = carryover_balance + gross_pay + adjustments_total formula implemented correctly
Daily breakdown includes day_name, total_hours_label, break_label, daily_pay, daily_adjustments, daily_final
Entry details include hours_minutes_label and break_label for all sources (manual, time_clock, job_timer)
OrderCommandBar component correctly renders on NewOrderForm and AddTicketToOrder pages with all action buttons
payrollExport.js correctly formats data for CSV and print exports with carryover, transactions, and final owed
seed_data_creation: Used main agent's seeded data: employee_id=admin-timeclock (Preview Payroll QA) with entries 2026-04-03 8h, 2026-04-08 7.5h, 2026-04-09 6.25h and transactions 2026-04-04 advance 40, 2026-04-08 earnings 25, 2026-04-09 payment 30
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll overhaul complete with carryover balance, transaction totals, and final owed calculations. Order Command Bar added to New Order and Add Ticket pages. All payroll endpoints (/api/payroll/report, /api/payroll/timesheet, /api/payroll/pay-period) return consistent data shapes for export functionality.
